title: Programming Language Benchmarks Dataset
subtitle: 2200+ benchmarks across 16 languages and 10 tasks
description: A synthetic dataset of 2200+ programming language benchmark results covering 16 popular languages across 10 computational tasks. Includes execution time, memory usage, lines of code, and language metadata. Useful for performance comparison, language selection analysis, and software engineering research.
